_comment: Review file for the slang extension. Copy to ./config/slang_review.json
(or point BOT_SLANG_REVIEW_PATH at it) and edit.
approve = let the bot understand this term, and (only if
BOT_SLANG_ALLOW_IMITATION=true) use it. reject = never inject it.
reset = drop any earlier decision and let it be a candidate again.
Reviewing is an authority that belongs to whoever deployed the bot. It is
deliberately a local file: there is no chat command, and no tool the model
can call to approve its own vocabulary. Reloaded on file change; a broken
file keeps the previous decisions and logs loudly rather than clearing
'meanings' is where you say what a term means in this group. A term with
no meaning is never injected — a bare word teaches the model nothing, so
approving without defining gets you nothing. Write the definition in your
A human meaning outranks anything inferred later: a re-learning pass cannot
overwrite it. To hand a term back to the model, write null for it (see
'reset' below) — that clears the override and lets inference resume.
The top-level lists apply to every group. A group that wants its own
decisions overrides them under 'scopes' by scope key (group:<群号>).

meanings.上大分: 本群指考得好、游戏大胜，或只是单纯拿到了好处
meanings.开摆: 放弃努力、摆烂，语气通常是自嘲

meanings.本群独有的说法: 这个群里它特指……（写清楚，否则不会被注入）
